1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a mature, poised woman; fair skin; softly squared face with a rounded jaw; medium-sized eyes — deep-set eyes, level outer eye corners; low heavy brows; straight narrow nose; full wide lips; navy-blue eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
Body and hair: broad-shouldered and strong build; a single thick braid over one shoulder with center-parted bangs framing the face; heavy dull blue-grey lead hair with a soft sheen.
Expression: a quiet, thoughtful look, lips lightly closed.
Her element, carried in her design: lead: a dull blue-grey metal, heavy and soft enough to scratch with a fingernail — the stable end where uranium's long decay chain finally comes to rest; the shield that stops X-rays and radiation, the dark came that joins the pieces of stained glass, the cast type of the printing press, the Roman water pipes that gave plumbing its name; alchemy's Saturn; it tastes sweet but is poison; heavy, quiet and guarding.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns.

Colours: dull lead blue-grey, deep indigo, ivory white, stained-glass ruby and amber accents.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: a Saturnine cathedral kingdom where all things come to rest: a vast ivory nave whose great rose windows are stained glass joined by dark lead came, roofs and spires sheathed in blue-grey lead sheet, ringed-planet emblems of Saturn carved in stone, cloisters so quiet that nothing seems to move.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow.

Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.
